# Setup mock source repository
mkdir source1/skill_a
exec axen init -d source1

# Add source with custom name
exec axen source add ./source1 --name custom-name

# Verify list shows the custom name
exec axen source list
stdout 'custom-name'

# Verify lockfile has the custom name
exists $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.axen/axen-lock.json
grep 'custom-name' $AXEN_TEST_HOME/.axen/axen-lock.json

-- source1/skill_a/SKILL.md --
---
name: skill-a
description: A mock skill
version: 1.0.0
---
Instruction for A
